quests.question: Nobody helped him with the experiment; he planned and ran it _____.
quests.explanation: 'Nobody helped him' shows he worked alone, so independently fits; jointly contradicts.

quests.question: Faced with a puzzle, he breaks it into parts, tests each and draws conclusions; his mind is _____.
quests.explanation: Breaking a puzzle into parts, testing each and concluding shows logical examination: analytical.

quests.question: Fresh from school, with no experience and plenty of confidence, the _____ youth advised the veterans.
quests.explanation: Fresh from school with no experience yet plenty of confidence describes an immature youth: callow.

quests.question: Though nobody checked, he reread every answer and corrected each error, working _____.
quests.explanation: Rereading and correcting even when nobody checks shows dutiful care: conscientiously.

quests.question: Staring out of the window and missing every instruction, the boy was _____.
quests.explanation: Staring out of the window and missing instructions show he wasn't paying attention: inattentive.

quests.question: At five, she read novels and corrected adults' grammar; she was remarkably _____ for her age.
quests.explanation: Reading novels and correcting adults at five shows early development, so precocious fits.

quests.question: He skimmed the instructions and tossed the parts together, assembling the shelf _____.
quests.explanation: Skimming instructions and tossing parts together show no care, so carelessly fits.

quests.question: The film was a puzzle of ideas with almost no action or emotion; as thrillers go, it was very _____.
quests.explanation: A puzzle of ideas with little action or emotion appeals to the intellect: cerebral.

quests.question: She turned old jars into lamps and wrote songs about rain; she is wonderfully _____.
quests.explanation: Turning old jars into lamps and writing songs show original ideas, so creative fits.

quests.question: Preferring novels to parties, the girl spent every weekend in the library; she was a _____ child.
quests.explanation: Preferring novels to parties and living in the library shows a love of reading: bookish.

quests.question: Eyes fixed on the speaker, leaning forward and never glancing away, she listened _____.
quests.explanation: Fixed eyes, leaning forward and never glancing away show deep concentration, so intently fits.

quests.question: He quoted Latin, discussed medieval law and cited obscure poets; he was widely known as _____.
quests.explanation: Quoting Latin, medieval law and obscure poets shows deep learning, so erudite fits.

quests.question: Everyone wanted to sit with her, and her party invitations were treasured; she was very _____.
quests.explanation: Everyone wanting to sit with her and valuing her invitations show she is well liked: popular.

quests.question: Students shouted, banged desks and threw paper planes across the room; the class was _____.
quests.explanation: Shouting, banging and throwing planes show noisy disorder, so rowdy fits; orderly contradicts.

quests.question: Told to sit, the puppy sat; told to stay, it stayed; it was very _____.
quests.explanation: Sitting and staying exactly when told shows it follows commands, so obedient fits.

quests.question: He scored 50 out of 100, exactly the class mean; his result was _____.
quests.explanation: Scoring exactly the class mean puts him in the middle, so average fits; outstanding contradicts.

quests.question: Every chat with the professor became a lecture, with him teaching rather than talking; his manner was _____.
quests.explanation: Turning every chat into a lecture shows an urge to teach and instruct, which is didactic; casual contradicts.

quests.question: The student explained quantum physics clearly in a two-minute talk; she is remarkably _____.
quests.explanation: Explaining a hard subject clearly in two minutes shows she expresses ideas well: articulate.

quests.question: After a year in Paris, she chatted with shopkeepers without stopping to search for words, speaking _____.
quests.explanation: Chatting without stopping to search for words shows smooth, easy speech, so fluently fits.

quests.question: He nodded, took notes and asked follow-up questions, listening _____.
quests.explanation: Nodding, note-taking and follow-up questions show he was paying full attention: attentively.

quests.question: He announced his own title three times, spoke in grand phrases and ignored questions; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Announcing his own title three times and using grand phrases show self-importance: pompous.

quests.question: Rather than accepting the article, he checked its sources and questioned its claims, reading _____.
quests.explanation: Checking sources and questioning claims shows careful judgment while reading: critically.

quests.question: At six, he solved algebra problems meant for teenagers; teachers called him _____.
quests.explanation: Solving teenage algebra at six shows exceptional ability, so gifted fits; backward contradicts.

quests.question: The twins hid the teacher's chalk, drew on the board and giggled; they were _____.
quests.explanation: Hiding chalk, drawing on the board and giggling show mischief, so naughty fits; angelic contradicts.

quests.question: She sang, played piano and wrote songs before she turned ten; she was _____.
quests.explanation: Singing, playing and writing songs before ten show natural ability, so talented fits.

quests.question: She reads in the library every evening, takes notes and finishes homework early; she is _____.
quests.explanation: Reading every evening, taking notes and finishing early show devotion to study: studious.

quests.question: Having never attended school, the old farmer could not read, but he knew every field; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Never attending school and not being able to read mean he lacked formal learning: unlettered.

quests.question: The students built the model together, sharing tasks and ideas; the project was _____.
quests.explanation: Building together and sharing tasks and ideas describes teamwork, so collaborative fits.

quests.question: Hands up before the question ended, Ben was _____ to answer.
quests.explanation: A hand up before the question ended shows eagerness, so keen fits; reluctant contradicts.

quests.question: He tapped his desk, shouted jokes and distracted every lesson; his behaviour was _____.
quests.explanation: Tapping, shouting jokes and distracting lessons interrupt others' learning, so disruptive fits.
